metadata.description:
Dataset and Documentation of Frida: The Danish Food Composition Database

Documentation for the database is available in Danish and English. The dataset contains several worksheets with the following tables:

  • Readme - Information on copyright and citation
  • Data_Table - Main table with all published nutrient data on all foods
  • Data_Normalised - All published nutrient data on all foods normalized with source/references
  • Food - Food description including FoodEx2, LanguaL and other codes
  • FoodGroup - Foodgroup description and hierarchy
  • Parameter - Food description including chemical data, EuroFIR and EFSA codes and identifiers for other databases
  • Source - Information on references including URL

How to refer to this dataset?

Marija Langwagen, Jette Jacobsen, Tue Christensen and Anders Poulsen: The Danish Food Composition Database, Frida version 5.5, November 2025, National Food Institute, Technical University of Denmark. https://doi.org/10.11583/DTU.29500682

  • Frida5.5_Dataset.xlsx - CC-BY 4.0
  • Frida5.5_Dataset.ods - CC-BY 4.0
  • Frida5.5_Dokumentation_Dansk.pdf - © Technical University of Denmark 2025
  • Frida5.5_Documentation_English.pdf - © Technical University of Denmark 2025
